patch_description:
This crossover retains the exact directed-Steiner dynamic programming optimizer from the current implementation for small and medium broadcast fanouts, while adding the multi-start zero-incremental-cost greedy strategy from the inspiration program as a scalable fallback and validation candidate.

The algorithm minimizes physical shared-link cost by selecting a directed multicast edge union rather than independently paying for source-to-destination paths. Exact Steiner search is used for up to 13 unique destinations, and the greedy implementation evaluates multiple initial trunks to avoid poor local attachment order for larger topologies. The resulting edge union is pruned, converted into valid source-rooted paths, and replicated across all partitions without redundant path computation.
